title: Doctor checks every account's runtime, the Herdr plugin and git fetch on this host
description: On a temporary home, a registry account whose runtime executable is missing and one whose PATH entry does not exist each yield one doctor FAIL line naming the account, the path and the fix; a missing Herdr graphyard plugin and a failing git remote each yield one line; with every executable, PATH entry, the plugin and the remote present doctor reports them PASS.
